original_ai_output.title_zh: 流离失所20年后，十字河州Ebijakara居民在卡拉巴尔抗议，要求返回祖传土地
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚十字河州Abi地方政府区Ebijakara社区的流离失所居民在州首府卡拉巴尔举行和平抗议，要求政府紧急介入，帮助他们返回祖传家园。抗议者称，20多年前因邻近社区冲突被迫逃离，长期流离失所导致多代人缺乏稳定住所、学校等基本设施，家庭分散各地。他们呼吁州长Bassey Otu尽快解决争端。报道为单一来源。

key_facts.fact: 十字河州Ebijakara社区流离失所居民在卡拉巴尔举行和平抗议
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The displaced people of Ebijakara Community in Abi Local Government Area of Cross River State have staged a peaceful protest in Calabar

key_facts.fact: 抗议者要求政府介入以返回祖传土地
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: demanding urgent government intervention to enable them to return to their ancestral home after spending at least 20 years in displacement

key_facts.fact: 居民称20多年前因邻近社区冲突被迫逃离
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: they were forced to flee their ancestral land more than 20 years ago following a communal clash involving a neighbouring community

key_facts.fact: 抗议者呼吁州长Bassey Otu紧急解决争端
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The protesters called on Governor Bassey Otu to urgently intervene in the dispute

uncertainties: 冲突起因及责任归属仅为抗议者单方说法，尚未获得独立证实
